body.p: A short letter describes a bustling market, a steady street, and a conversation about proof, inquiry, and public trust. The whole scene is simple and vivid. David Hume

One speaker is patient, another impatient, and a third prefers examples drawn from daily work. They are not debating a myth; they are naming features of the visible world, with substance entering the discussion. François-Marie Voltaire
At the end, the sentence settles into a cautious conclusion and the room becomes quiet again. Public criticism remains the final note.
